plugins_comment: pnpm links node_modules/@stryker-mutator/* with symlinks and auto-discovery does not follow them: they have to be listed by hand.
inPlace_comment: No sandbox: the tests read ../spec/hash-vectors.json, which would be outside it. Stryker restores src/ when it finishes; do not edit src/ while it runs. `make check` fails if instrumentation leftovers remain.
thresholds_comment: No breaking threshold: scripts/mutation-score.mjs is the guard, against mutation-baseline.json.
